# netcup_server_disks (Data Source)

The disks of a netcup server (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_disks" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `disks` (Attributes List) Disks of the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))

<a id="nestedatt--disks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disks`

Read-Only:

- `allocation_in_mib` (Number) Allocated size in MiB.
- `capacity_in_mib` (Number) Capacity in MiB.
- `name` (String) Name of the disk.
- `storage_driver` (String) Storage driver of the disk.
